title: Didn't notice the spots!
text: Didn't notice the spots!. Well it looks slightly different from the picture.  I didn't notice all the white spots on it from the website picture's.  It seems more white than grey. But I will be keeping it however because at least it's in a dark area of my room. Had I known that it was mostly white than grey though I wouldn't have bought it. Oh well live and learn!
